ar: وَ يَا بَاعِثُ ابْعَثْنَا عَلَى خَيْرِ حَالَةٍ
en: O Resurrector, resurrect us in the best of states – Witness, have us witness Your Highness in our assembly

tr: Wa Yā Ḥaqqu ḥaqqiqnā bi sirrin muqaddasin
en: O Truth, actualize us by a sanctified secret – Benefactor, we rely on You, by You we are sufficed

ar: وَلِيٌّ حَمِيْدٌ لَيْسَ إِلَّا لَكَ الثَّنَا
en: Almighty Relentless, strengthen my resolve and aspiration – Safeguard, Praiseworthy, no one but You deserve praise
O Numerator of things, O Originator of mortals – Favor us with happiness and mirth

ar: عَلَى الدِّيْنِ يَا مُحْيِي الْأَنَامِ مِنَ الْفَنَا
tr: A`idnā bi nūrin Yā Mu`īdu wa aḥyinā
en: Return us with light, O Restorer, and revive us - On the religion, O Life-Giver of creatures, from annihilation
